comments.body: Could you diff the two configs (using `bazel config`) and see what's different?
This could be due to the test trimming transition affecting the set of loaded packages through config fields (e.g. `lcov_merger`). Just a guess at this point though.

That's the effect of test trimming, which effectively removes the reference to `coverage_support`, which in turn affects loaded transitive packages. Perhaps the easiest fix is to move `coverage_support` to `CoverageOptions` and don't trim it.
A workaround is to enable `--experimental_retain_test_configuration_across_testonly`, which avoids the configuration forking.
Shouldn't this be added to the 8.5.1 release?

A fix for this issue has been included in [Bazel 8.5.1 RC2](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/releases/tag/8.5.1rc2). Please test out the release candidate and report any issues as soon as possible.
If you're using Bazelisk, you can point to the latest RC by setting USE_BAZEL_VERSION=8.5.1rc2. Thanks!
